'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Scott Lingrell LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
